premise: After my half-brother begged me to save his failing bakery with my $90,000 nursing pension, he promised in writing to repay with interest; instead, he fled the state, reopened under his wife’s name, and blocked my calls; I found him through a pie contest flyer, enforced the judgment, and now he scrubs mixing bowls in his old bakery, which I renamed ‘Crust of Consequences,’ wearing a shirt that says ‘Rolled Over My Trust’ while every bread bag prints his fraud case number.
